title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a mathematical note. It is a typed errata sheet titled 'Corrections à apporter à S.G.A.D. XV, XVI, XVII', with a few handwritten touch-ups. 'SGAD' is SGA 3, Schémas en groupes (Demazure–Grothendieck). A long diagonal pen stroke runs across the whole sheet, probably marking it as dealt with or superseded. It sits by accident in a folder of notes on Poincaré–Hodge algebras. The previous and next pages hold the 'algèbres de Hodge d'ordre 2' computations, which this sheet interrupts.

The items are page and line corrections, mostly to Exp. XV (sub-tori, Cartan subgroups and smooth group schemes):
- Cross-references to Exp. XVII, Appendix III, items 1, 2 and 3. These are added after Prop. 1.2, and at pp. 60, 85/87 and 123.
- Corrected references: Exp. VII 8.4; Exp. X 4.8 a); XII 6.6 c); XIV 4.8 and 4.8 bis; EGA IV 8 and 6.3.
- Deletion of a reference to Exp. VI_B 5.2.
- Renumbering 'Remarque 6.3' to 'Remarque 6.2.1'.
- A missing vertical arrow M(S'') → M(Ŝ'') in a diagram.
- Letter fixes: C' → T', and dim H_t → dim L_t.

The only correction with mathematical content is at p. 81, a standard spreading-out argument. Suppose the generic fibre H_η of a subgroup H ⊂ G contains a Cartan subgroup C_η of G_η. After shrinking the base S, C_η extends to a Cartan subgroup C of G, which one may assume lies inside H. This uses the result just proved in the text: Cartan subgroups of the generic fibre extend locally. This is routine SGA 3 Exp. XV material on Cartan subgroups of smooth group schemes.
errors: The ordering 'Page 87 … Page 86 … Page 87' suggests the first entry may really be 'Page 85'. The typescript as imaged reads 87, so this is either a typing slip in the errata sheet or a misreading of a faint digit.

ideas.what: Spreading out a Cartan subgroup of the generic fibre to a Cartan subgroup of G over a neighbourhood, contained in a given subgroup H (corrected argument, p. 81 of Exp. XV)
ideas.modern_name: Extension of Cartan subgroups / maximal tori from the generic fibre (limit arguments for smooth group schemes)
ideas.where_published: SGA 3 Exp. XV (and the corrected re-edition by Gille–Polo)

ideas.what: Cross-references to the appendix of Exp. XVII (Appendix III) and to Exp. X, XII, XIV and EGA IV

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine typed errata list for SGA 3 Exp. XV–XVII, misfiled among the Poincaré–Hodge algebra notes. It contains no new mathematics, and such corrections were presumably absorbed into the published or re-edited SGA 3.
